newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices steady at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices steady at weekly auction.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices were mostly steady at the weekly auction, brokers said.

Overseas buyers were active, but local buyers and blenders showed a lack of interest. "Overseas buyers offered higher prices for brokens and fannings teas. But local traders were reluctant to pay higher prices and mostly kept to the sidelines," one broker said.
The average price was 72.69 taka per kg, up 0.08 taka from the previous sale. Some 598,220 kg was sold at the auction. The next sale will be held on August 5 with an offer of 925,000 kg.
